mechanism: Design one original dossier frame with a fixed portrait zone, fixed title position, fixed field order and stable sequence counter. Cycle at least five distinct archetypes through that exact registration. For each entry, change at least four coordinated channels: dominant accent color, silhouette or body geometry, posture or micro-action, and one role-specific symbol or data motif. Hold each plate long enough for the title and one visual distinction to register, then replace the subject without sliding the interface. End on the final numbered plate rather than a generic montage. The reusable mechanism is fixed taxonomy plus coordinated archetype contrast—not the source seven-sins theme, character faces, bodies, names, costumes, poses, exact palette, wording, logo, interface ornament, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Lock portrait zone, title position, field order and sequence counter across every entry.
invariants.ablation_failure: Moving fields force viewers to relearn the interface for each role.

invariants.rule: Present at least five distinct archetypes in a declared numbered sequence.
invariants.purpose: Builds a genuine roster rather than isolated character cards.
invariants.ablation_failure: Too few entries or missing order cannot prove a taxonomy.

invariants.rule: Change accent color, silhouette, posture and one role symbol together for every archetype.
invariants.purpose: Makes each role legible through multiple independent channels.
invariants.ablation_failure: Palette-only swaps feel cosmetic and silhouettes alone lack functional meaning.

invariants.rule: Give every plate one readable title and one brief character micro-action while keeping the interface static.
invariants.purpose: Combines classification clarity with living presence.
invariants.ablation_failure: No hold prevents reading; full animation overwhelms the comparison frame.

invariants.rule: Finish on the final numbered dossier plate with all shared anchors intact.
invariants.ablation_failure: A generic collage or disappearing interface breaks the promised sequence.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source seven-deadly-sins concept, exact role names, character identities, faces, bodies and gender presentation
the source armor, crowns, gloves, fitted suits, poses, expressions and role symbols
the source gold, orange, magenta, green, amber, red and violet palette assignments
the source SE7ENS logo, English copy, metrics, counters, interface ornament, font and graphic timing
the source creator identity, MiniMax H3 claim, platform overlay, watermark and branding
